title: steering.stage_backlog activity input
description: WS-04 (XD-FIX-R1-100, XD-W2-01-05). Input of replicant-worker activity `steering.stage_backlog`, logical activity ID `<node>.c<c>.n<segment>.steering`. The workflow passes the queued `job.steer` messages for the next node. Their text exists only in workflow state (C-MSG `job.steer`: text inline in history), so it is carried here as `messages[]`. The activity writes each message once (If-None-Match: *) as a `steering_message` object under `steps/<node>.c<c>.n<o>/steering_message/<message_id>.json` and returns the keys (`#/$defs/result`). Rule the schema cannot express: the set of `messages[].message_id` must equal `message_ids[]`, in the same order. On a mismatch the activity fails non-retryably (`steering_backlog_mismatch`). The text is untrusted: `context.stage_inputs` renders it only inside `<untrusted_input source="steering">`.

messages.description: XD-W2-01-05. One item per message_ids entry, same order, from the workflow's steering log.

author.description: JobSteerRequest.actor.principal_id after the workflow's identity.check_action(steer) allowed it (only usr_ may steer).

keys.description: Object keys written (or already present with the same sha256), in message_ids order.
